entities.summary: Tamar Khmiadashvili was a Georgian chess player, who was awarded the title of Woman Grandmaster (WGM) by FIDE in 1998 for winning Women's Senior Chess Championship. She won the Georgian Women's Championship in 1972, 1975 and 1978, the European Women's Senior Championship in 2010, and the World Women's Senior Championship in 1998, 1999, 2003, 2010 and 2017. She placed second in the latter event in 1995–1997. In 2007, she was also accorded the FIDE Arbiter title.
